title: Joseph, Bring Us Close to Jesus
style: High-energy contemporary gospel with a joyful, driving handclap groove and a warm, commanding baritone lead in clear call-and-response with a full, diverse mixed choir. Begin with a brief piano-and-clap pickup; build verses with piano, Hammond organ, bass, punchy live drums, and bright brass accents; open into a soaring choir-led refrain with stacked harmonies, fervent ad-libs, and strong rhythmic claps. Add a dynamic breakdown that spotlights the soloist and choir answering, then rise into a triumphant final refrain. Organic, communal, polished live-room energy, crisp vocal-forward mix.
lyrics:
[Intro]
Lead: O most holy Joseph!
Choir: Faithful guardian, hear our prayer!

[Verse 1]
Lead: Spouse of Mary, chosen father,
Choir: Joseph, walk with us in love!
Lead: God entrusted you with wonder,
Choir: Grace was poured on you from above!
Lead: For this calling, for these blessings,
Choir: Thanks to God, our voices rise!
Lead: For the gifts that crowned your greatness,
Choir: Praise be lifted to the skies!

[Chorus]
Lead: Joseph, bring us close to Jesus!
Choir: Draw us near, draw us near!
Lead: Let our hearts burn with desire!
Choir: We long to behold him here!
Lead: Till we see him face to face,
Choir: In heaven, in heaven!
All: We will rejoice in his divine embrace!

[Verse 2]
Lead: By the love you bore the Child,
Choir: Pray our longing may grow strong!
Lead: Turn our hearts toward his presence,
Choir: Teach our souls to sing his song!
Lead: Let us welcome him with fervor,
Choir: Let our spirits answer, “Yes!”
Lead: In the sacrament receive him,
Choir: Fill our lives with holiness!

[Chorus]
Lead: Joseph, bring us close to Jesus!
Choir: Draw us near, draw us near!
Lead: Let our hearts burn with desire!
Choir: We long to behold him here!
Lead: Till we see him face to face,
Choir: In heaven, in heaven!
All: We will rejoice in his divine embrace!

[Bridge]
Lead: When the road is long—
Choir: Stay beside us!
Lead: When our hope feels small—
Choir: Remind us of him!
Lead: Guide us to the Child—
Choir: Jesus, our joy!
Lead: Lead us home to him—
Choir: Amen, amen!

[Final Chorus]
Lead: Joseph, bring us close to Jesus!
Choir: Draw us near, draw us near!
Lead: Let our hearts burn with desire!
Choir: We long to behold him here!
Lead: Till we see him face to face,
Choir: In heaven, in heaven!
All: We will rejoice in his divine embrace!

[Outro]
Lead: O most holy Joseph—
Choir: Pray for us!
All: Amen!
